paragraphs: Hello! I am Tom. Today I make a paper plane. Dad shows me how. You can make one too. A paper plane is a fun toy. You can play with it in the park. Get one paper. Get green and orange crayons. Do you want to try?

One, put the paper on the table. Two, fold the paper. Three, fold it again. Four, fold the paper to the line. Five, fold it to the line again. Six, color the plane green. Seven, make three orange lines on it. Look! You have a paper plane.

Now we go to the park. The sky is blue and the sun is big. Hold the plane in your hand. Throw it! The plane flies in the sky. Pip runs and runs. He catches the plane! "Good dog, Pip!" says Dad. Can you throw it again? Dad and I run in the park too. Pip wants to play. He is very happy!
text.summary: Tom shows how to make a paper plane in seven steps. Then he throws it in the park, and Pip catches it.
